info.title: Internal Messenger Operator and Adapter API v2
info.description: Route map of the implemented v2 API. Operator and internal CRM paths use staffSession or adapterService security; auth, OAuth and channel webhook paths override it explicitly.

adapterService.description: Dedicated internal adapter service identity; never use operator cookie for internal CRM ingestion.

adminBootstrapToken.description: One-time ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN that may create the first administrator of a company. The route exists only while the deployment configures the token; clear it once an administrator exists.

get.description: Lists workshops visible to the session. Requires role read. A workshop-scoped session sees only its own workshop; a company-level session sees all.

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below read

post.description: Creates or upserts a workshop by id (the id is the identity; idempotencyKey is accepted but never changes the outcome). Requires role admin. A workshop-scoped session may only submit its own workshop id; any other id is 404.

400.description: Body failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below admin

404.description: Workshop id outside the session scope

get.description: Lists connection routes assigned to the workshop. Requires role read. A foreign or missing workshop is 404.

400.description: Path parameter failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below read

404.description: Workshop not found or outside the session scope

post.description: Creates or updates the route of a connection inside the workshop. Requires role admin. The route of a connection belongs to one workshop: moving it through another workshop endpoint is 404. A stale expectedVersion is 409 with x-current-version and x-route-version headers.

400.description: Path parameter or body failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below admin

404.description: Workshop, connection, or route scope not found

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT: expectedVersion is stale; the current version is in x-current-version and x-route-version

get.description: Lists group policy rules of the workshop. Requires role read. Optional connectionId must be routed to this workshop, otherwise 404.

400.description: Path parameter or query failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below read

404.description: Workshop or routed connection not found

post.description: Sets the group policy rule for one external chat. Requires role manage. The connection must be routed to this workshop, otherwise 404.

400.description: Path parameter or body failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below manage

404.description: Workshop or routed connection not found

get.description: Lists per-connection staff permissions inside the workshop. Requires role read. Optional connectionId must be routed to this workshop, otherwise 404.

400.description: Path parameter or query failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below read

404.description: Workshop or routed connection not found

get.description: Returns the assignment policy (source of truth) and its version. Requires role read. Absence of a stored row is the documented default: platform, version 0.

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below read

post.description: Changes the assignment policy with compare-and-set. Requires role admin. A stale expectedVersion is 409 with x-current-version and x-policy-version headers; the error body stays a plain ApiError.

400.description: Body failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below admin

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT: expectedVersion is stale; the current version is in x-current-version and x-policy-version

get.description: Lists open assignment conflicts, optionally narrowed by account and conversation. Requires role read. A conversation or account outside the session scope is 404.

400.description: Query failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below read

404.description: Conversation or account not found or outside the session scope

post.description: Requests a CRM synchronization for one conversation. Requires role manage. Account and conversation must be visible in the session scope, otherwise 404. idempotencyKey makes a replay return the stored result.

400.description: Body failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below manage

404.description: Account or conversation not found or outside the session scope

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT: concurrent modification, retry the request

get.description: Returns sync state, owner projection, open conflict count, binding summary and the linked-card URL for one conversation. Requires role read. accountId and conversationId are mandatory; a foreign scope is 404.

400.description: Query failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

403.description: Session role is below read

404.description: Account or conversation not found or outside the session scope

post.description: Authenticates a staff member and issues the staff_session cookie. No session is required. Attempts are throttled per IP/company/staff before any password check; a blocked attempt is 429 with retry-after, and password-check capacity exhaustion is 503 RATE_LIMITED.

200.description: Session issued; the staff_session cookie is set and the response must not be cached

400.description: Body failed validation

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: unknown company/staff or wrong password

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many attempts; retry-after carries the delay in seconds

503.description: RATE_LIMITED: password-check capacity is busy; retry-after is 1 second

post.description: Creates the first administrator of a company and its staff grant. Requires Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN; when the token is not configured the route is not registered and answers 404. The company is created when absent. The call is accepted at most once per company: a company that already has an administrator answers 409 and nothing is changed. The password and its hash never appear in the response or the logs.

201.description: Administrator created; the response carries identifiers only

400.description: Body failed validation

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or wrong bootstrap token

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT: the company already has an administrator; nothing was changed

post.description: Revokes the current session and clears the staff_session cookie. Requires a verified session; the request body must be empty when present.

204.description: Session revoked and the staff_session cookie cleared

400.description: Body failed validation

401.description: No verified staff session

get.description: Starts the amoCRM OAuth flow and redirects to the provider. Authorized either by an admin staff session or, for first-time setup before any staff account exists, by the one-time setup token passed as the setup query parameter. Without either, 401.

302.description: Redirect to the amoCRM authorization page

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: neither an admin session nor a valid setup token

502.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: the provider authorization URL could not be built

parameters.name: setup
parameters.description: One-time setup token; compared in constant time with the configured value

get.description: OAuth redirect target. No session is required. Exchanges code/state for tokens and renders an HTML result page; a missing or rejected code is a 400 HTML page, not an ApiError.

200.description: HTML page: tokens received and stored encrypted

400.description: HTML page: code/state missing, rejected or expired

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code from amoCRM; validated at runtime

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: OAuth state from amoCRM; validated at runtime

post.description: Revokes the stored amoCRM OAuth tokens for the session company. Requires role admin.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: no session or role below admin

502.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: the provider revocation call failed

post.description: Telegram Bot API update webhook. No staff session: the request is authenticated only by x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token, compared in constant time with the configured webhook secret. Unknown connections and connections of another channel are both 404.

200.description: Update stored or recognized as a duplicate

400.description: invalid_update: body failed the update schema

401.description: unauthorized: missing or wrong secret header

404.description: connection_not_found: no such connection or it is not a Telegram channel

409.description: ambiguous_connection or payload_conflict

503.description: telegram_not_configured: no webhook secret is configured

parameters.name: x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token
parameters.description: Secret token configured for the Telegram webhook

post.description: WhatsApp Cloud API webhook. No staff session: the exact received bytes must carry a valid x-hub-signature-256 HMAC (sha256=<hex>) computed with the app secret. Verification precedes any database access.

200.description: Events stored; duplicates are reported separately

400.description: invalid_update: malformed payload

401.description: unauthorized: missing or invalid signature

404.description: connection_not_found: no such connection or it is not a WhatsApp channel

409.description: ambiguous_connection or payload_conflict

413.description: Request body exceeds the 1 MiB webhook limit; rejected before parsing (framework error shape)

503.description: whatsapp_not_configured: WhatsApp is not configured

parameters.name: x-hub-signature-256
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the exact request bytes, formatted as sha256=<hex>

get.description: Meta subscription handshake. No session and no database access: the challenge is echoed only when hub.mode=subscribe and hub.verify_token equals the configured verify token.

200.description: The hub.challenge value echoed as text

400.description: missing_challenge

403.description: invalid_subscription_request

503.description: whatsapp_not_configured

post.description: MAX Bot API webhook. No staff session: authenticated only by x-max-bot-api-secret, compared with the configured webhook secret.

200.description: Events stored; duplicates are reported separately

400.description: invalid_update: malformed payload

401.description: unauthorized: missing or wrong secret header

404.description: connection_not_found: no such connection or it is not a MAX channel

409.description: ambiguous_connection or payload_conflict

413.description: Request body exceeds the 1 MiB webhook limit; rejected before parsing (framework error shape)

503.description: max_not_configured: MAX is not configured

parameters.name: x-max-bot-api-secret
parameters.description: Secret configured for the MAX webhook

post.description: VK Callback API webhook. No staff session: the secret is a body field compared with the configured secret. A confirmation event is answered with text/plain before any database access; other events are stored and acknowledged as JSON.

200.description: Confirmation code as text, or stored-events JSON

400.description: invalid_update: malformed payload

401.description: unauthorized: missing or wrong body secret

404.description: connection_not_found: no such connection or it is not a VK channel

409.description: ambiguous_connection or payload_conflict

413.description: Request body exceeds the 1 MiB webhook limit; rejected before parsing (framework error shape)

503.description: vk_not_configured: VK is not configured

get.description: VK Callback API confirmation handshake. No session: the confirmation code is returned only for type=confirmation and an existing VK connection.

403.description: invalid_confirmation_request

404.description: connection_not_found

409.description: ambiguous_connection

503.description: vk_not_configured

post.description: amoCRM Chats webhook. No staff session: x-signature is verified over the exact received bytes with the channel secret before JSON parsing. Unknown or disabled scopes and bad signatures are deliberately indistinguishable (401). The durable inbox write is awaited before the 202 because amoCRM does not redeliver.

202.description: Event accepted or recognized as a duplicate

400.description: invalid_payload: body is not a JSON object

401.description: invalid_signature: unknown/disabled scope or bad signature

403.description: scope_mismatch: account_id does not match the channel account

413.description: Request body exceeds the 1 MiB webhook limit; rejected before parsing (framework error shape)

503.description: channel_secret_unavailable or storage_unavailable

parameters.name: x-signature
parameters.description: Provider signature of the exact request bytes
